intent: Carry the three remaining visual dependency proposals from PRs #225, #230 and #232 onto current dev through one regenerated lockfile, verify rendered behaviour at desktop and phone widths, and retire only these addressed PR branches after exact-head preservation and hosted acceptance.

reasons.evidence: Closing addressed PRs and removing their remote source branches is externally consequential; the operator explicitly authorised cleanup after preserving important work.
The dependency update is pushed to dev and triggers hosted CI.

programme: T-0175 dev@c13872c7 passed push CI and both Gitleaks workflows. Its PR CI attempt 1 failed real-Hermes before contract tests because the PatterStage container reported EADDRINUSE on 0.0.0.0:42069; downstream acceptance was red. The same commit's isolated real-Hermes rerun, attempt 2, passed, then acceptance-gate passed. Both attempts remain recorded; the intermittent Docker bind cause is unresolved and cannot be treated as a product assertion failure. PRs #225, #230 and #232 are open against dev at their preservation-ledger heads, changing only package.json and package-lock.json. Their proposals are @xyflow/react 12.11.6, @tailwindcss/postcss 4.3.3 and lucide-react 1.41.0. The remaining Knip, Playwright and React pair proposals stay open for later batches.
invariants: Only the three named direct package ranges change; regenerate package-lock.json on current dev and account for every transitive delta against the source PRs.
Freeze an independent seven-name or stronger oracle red before package edits. Preserve existing test identities and coverage floors.

Walk controlled graph, icon and responsive layouts on an isolated production instance at 1440x900 and 390x844. Record screenshot hashes, console errors, missing h1 and horizontal overflow; distinguish a dependency-induced defect from the existing baseline.

Run an isolated npm ci, focused tests, npm audit with remaining advisories reported, the full ten-step unchanged-tree gate, and a committed-tree mutation sweep. Do not weaken any gate to accommodate dependency changes.

Keep each PR open until its exact proposal is represented on dev and all hosted jobs pass. Archive each exact head locally before closure; issue a remote deletion only under an exact-SHA lease if closure leaves that head present.
At most two disjoint writing lanes are active. Only dev is pushed; main, PR #157, unaddressed PRs and dirty worktrees remain intact.
rollback: Restore the three former direct ranges and regenerate the lockfile in a new dev commit. Retain the oracle and archived exact PR heads so every proposal is recoverable.
verify_line: The frozen oracle, visual walk, focused tests, full unchanged-tree gate, lockfile audit, committed-tree sweep, hosted jobs and exact-head PR archive/ref checks must pass; npm audit is run and its unresolved advisories reported separately.
